CheckTitle: Ensure Potential Ghost Employees Are Monitored
Benchmark: CIS Oracle SaaS Cloud Applications Benchmark v1.0.0
SubSectionName: Application Business User Separation of Duties (SoD)
RequiredAccess: Fusion pod HCM REST with Basic Auth (ORACLE_FUSION_*): userAccounts with userAccountRoles
Fusion payroll and time-card reports for transaction review
Description: Employees paid without evidence of work (payroll entries without time entries) should be monitored.
Risk: Ghost employees are a classic payroll fraud.
AuditProcedure: Identify payroll entries without time or other evidence of work.
Automated alternative: deploy the matching Transaction/Access Controls in Fusion Cloud Applications Risk Management so changes start an investigation workflow. Examples: 50003, 50004.

Steps: Terminate the employment or monitor the user and the hiring managers' transactions.

Notes: Reads every Fusion user's role assignments from the HCM REST API. FAIL when an active user holds a hiring role together with a payroll/payment or time-card role (the access behind CIS example controls 50003/50004 and security_platform's HR Specialist + Payroll Manager SoD rule). Payroll transactions without evidence of work are not visible here.
